## DecodedDirectSignal type

The direct signal handed to listeners. Holochain treats the payload as opaque bytes, so it is surfaced as a `Uint8Array`<!-- -->; the application decides how to decode it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type DecodedDirectSignal = {
    cell_id: CellId;
    from_agent: AgentPubKey;
    signal: Uint8Array;
};
```
**References:** [CellId](./client.cellid.md)<!-- -->, [AgentPubKey](./client.agentpubkey.md)
